how: Repeated calls recruit people to build bigger flags and defend two reported Maltese flags.
Participants choose hearts, correct white pixels, enlarge flags, and debate where the subreddit name could fit.
Reports describe flags as nearly done, newly started, missing, or present again in a Maltese heart.
Coordinate requests, location links, and a rough sketch make successive flag and heart proposals findable.
An erasure alarm calls everyone to defend the new flag, followed by a report that the attack was fended off.
Blame of named neighbours is contested by a helper who denies that the overwriting is an attack from the named subreddit.
A French-identified visitor asks Maltese participants to stop changing the French flag, without a recorded Maltese response demonstrating compliance.
Negotiation specifies a small flag inside the host flag, its dimensions, its location, and promised defense.
A heart proposal and a visitor's interference allegation do not establish an executed Maltese attack or identify its perpetrators.
Reporting no surviving flags prompts a new heart proposal, which receives a later report that the heart is Maltese.
A contribution title, named shoutouts, and closing thanks mark participants' efforts without proving that every displayed attempt survived.
A timed image update, a title reporting a short-lived attempt, and the ending announcement record the work during and after its making.
Calling the effort a legacy does not specify a successor canvas, enduring organization, reused emblem, or decision to continue ties.
Coordinate instructions show how to find the heart but leave placement scripts, spare accounts, and their use unobserved.
Bare agreement accepts a proposal to seek help, while another short assent backs approaching France.
Members seek French and Italian help, report assistance, and propose reciprocal defense after protecting their own flag.
The reported protection arrangement and a call for reciprocal defense instantiate a minimal alliance without demonstrating durable organization or actual reciprocal placement.
Blaming named subreddits and insulting French people carries pixel disputes into hostile talk without establishing an organized Maltese attack.
A small guest flag is offered space inside a larger French flag with promised protection.
Calls and contribution titles provide no evidence of a host-sub rule, megathread decision, removal policy, or objection to canvas posting.
Replying to promised protection, a helper states that competing host-side placers defeated their control, limiting what the agreement could secure.
The closing thanks contain no dispute about cleanup, keeping damage, or correcting a retained version of the event.
A private-message link accompanies reported defense terms without showing the room's planning moving into a chat or revealing how those terms were decided.
A question about what is happening at a flag receives blame and then a corrective explanation with an offer of help.
A proposed subreddit inscription and a foreign helper's intervention do not identify anyone who says the canvas mark brought them into the room.
The Azure Window comparison and the joke about French rule turn canvas difficulties into local jokes without demonstrating a continuing running gag.
Participants choose an empty premade heart to save time and propose moving a more-or-less finished flag to make it bigger.
Considering writing the subreddit name on a shared flag does not show a new room forming around a canvas mark.
Hostile national language is recorded, but an objection to its offensiveness, correction, apology, or enforcement remains unobserved.
The operation title leaves its addressee unknown and cannot establish outreach to creators, press, a team, or another outside audience.
A request to stop altering the French flag does not establish a debate comparing the fairness of covering work with freedom to change the canvas.
An apology for failed guest protection does not establish a member leaving under strain or an internal personal quarrel being repaired.
Using Maltese to report an appeal and mentioning writing French do not establish concealing plans from rivals or infiltrating their venues.
Neither a defense call nor the operation title establishes resentment of canvas posting causing an attack on the room's own mark.
The operation's surviving title cannot determine whether its deleted body staged a separate April Fools prank or meant a canvas effort.
The explicit judgment that the group is small motivates asking other subreddits for help.
A historical joke about French rule does not establish an active pre-canvas quarrel carried into the event.
The Azure Window comparison and a joke about French rule turn canvas loss and non-help into local historical references.
The flag being gone overnight does not establish individual sleep, schedules, devices, or costs of participating.
Asking what is happening at the flag location does not establish a stale canvas, timer fault, or site malfunction.
A French helper's intervention does not establish professed membership in both rooms or divided belonging.
Visible suggestions and replies do not establish the absence of decided organization elsewhere or test a cross-room prevalence claim.
The historical comparison mocks non-help without calling for an attack, leaving a prior tie naming a target during an attack unobserved.
Members start new flags or supply heart designs, with subsequent invitations to join treated separately from the starter role.
Members link external appeals and bring back reports that assistance has arrived or been promised.
The explanation by uninformed repair requires evidence of misunderstood changes, which the helper's account of incompatible aims does not supply.
Promised guest protection depends on more than permission when helpers report losing control to placers who want an exclusive host flag.
Read before any loss at the attempt level, because choices for expansion and faster construction continue after an earlier flag disappears.
Promised protection is an explicit reason to choose a new location, beyond seeking more space or faster construction.
Relocation re-enters building and reporting when the replacement-heart proposal is answered by a report that the heart is now Maltese.
A defense call precedes a progress report, but the report does not attribute the writer's participation to that call.
A proposed heart sketch receives a design correction and an explicit invitation to get started.
An explicitly new flag becomes something to defend from erasure, followed by a reported successful defense.
Complaints about French overwriting prompt a request to speak to the French and a reply offering permitted space and help.
A visitor appeals for restraint, but a settled border producing Maltese compliance is unobserved.
Defense pressure and failed protection are visible, but a resulting turn to scripts or spare accounts is unobserved.
A completed-heart report and later thanks do not identify the report as the cause of collective celebration.
Early recording and a later closing celebration do not establish celebration producing subsequent preservation.
The closing legacy statement supplies no observable decision to carry the recorded effort into a continuing activity.
Judging the flags absent explicitly motivates making another one and receives a replacement-heart proposal without an explicit manpower assessment or abandonment decision.
Coordinates answer a location request for an already proposed heart, without demonstrating a template settling a design dispute.
Bare assents answer proposals to seek outside help, leaving direct acceptance of a placing call and the proposed acceptance preference unobserved.
Defensive strain leads to requests and reported help, but sustained protection remains contingent when helpers report losing control to competing placers.
The negotiated location explicitly carries promised defense, tying permitted space to assistance rather than proving delivered protection.
The heart proposal and a visitor's later interference complaint do not identify an attack call answering a call to build.
A French visitor's request to stop does not document a Maltese refusal or apology answering a Maltese attack call.
The permitted-space offer answers a request to speak after complaints of overwriting, rather than an identified Maltese attack call.
Hostile talk about overwriting is visible, but a preceding Maltese attack producing that talk is unobserved.
The protection bargain and reciprocal-defense call do not establish that a shared threat caused both sides to form their arrangement.
Repeated calls are recorded, but a resulting flood and host-sub boundary response remain unobserved.
The reported protection agreement receives a direct reply explaining failed delivery through competing host-side aims and loss of control.
